discrepancies.why: The OM labels the income as the current rent roll, but the figure is stated at 100% occupancy while the same OM gives occupancy of 91%. The 7.21% gross yield therefore counts rent on vacant units that is not being earned. It is a gross figure on asking price, with no operating costs deducted, so it overstates what a buyer would receive today.
discrepancies.analyst_action: Request the dated rent roll with contracted rent for let units only. Recompute the in-place gross and net yield on let units, and reconcile the result to the trailing 12-month P&L.

discrepancies.why: The OM bases the uplift on asking rents for new lettings. Increases on existing tenancies can only happen at renewal, are capped in bands by the gap to the RERA rental index, and need 90 days' notice. The OM does not mention these limits or the 2026 fall in market rents. The claimed rise of c.AED 1.15m (+12%) in 12 months is therefore unlikely to be achievable and should not be used in pricing.
discrepancies.analyst_action: Do not underwrite the uplift. Obtain the lease expiry schedule and test each renewal against the RERA rental index calculator. Compare passing rents with achieved 2026 transactions, not asking rents.

memo.markdown:
## Verdict
**Needs work**: the deal is blocked because the unit count is not established, so the minimum and maximum unit tests cannot run.

Minimum unit count is not known; confirm before any further work. Maximum unit count is not known; confirm before any further work. The mandate range is 30 [[mandate.min_units.threshold]] to 250 [[mandate.max_units.threshold]] units. Nothing else matters until this is resolved. There is no walk-away price and no buy recommendation.

## The deal
- **What and where:** Bramble Heights, Jumeirah Village Circle (District 16), market area JVC, completed 2023 [[deal.completion_year]], G+P+10. The OM states 122 units [[om.unit_count]], but the screen does not treat the count as known. Freehold, single title.
- **Price:** asking AED 146.0m [[deal.asking_price_aed]]. The OM quotes AED 1,539 per sq ft [[om.price_psf_stated]] on NSA of 94,861 sq ft [[om.nsa_sqft]]. BUA is 133,610 sq ft [[deal.bua_sqft]].
- **Income:** direct leases, no master tenant, tenants pay chiller. The OM states 91% occupancy [[om.occupancy_stated]] and annual rent of AED 10.5m [[om.annual_rent_stated]], which is potential rent, not rent being earned. The operating statement shows rental income of AED 9.7m [[opex.rental_income]], expenses of AED 1.8m [[opex.total_expenses_aed]] (18% [[opex.opex_ratio]] of income) and NOI of AED 7.9m [[opex.noi_aed]] before the screen's adjustments. The OM gives no net income or operating cost figure.

## Returns
The deal was not underwritten, so there are no returns. These mandate tests could not be run:
- going-in net yield on total cost, 6.0% [[mandate.min_going_in_net_yield_on_cost.threshold]] minimum
- unlevered IRR, 7.5% [[mandate.target_unlevered_irr.threshold]] target
- unlevered equity multiple, 1.30x [[mandate.target_unlevered_equity_multiple.threshold]] target
- occupancy, 90% [[mandate.min_occupancy.threshold]] minimum
- largest quarterly lease expiry share, 40% [[mandate.max_lease_expiry_share_in_any_quarter.threshold]] maximum
- share of income let above the screen reference, 20% [[mandate.max_over_rent_share_of_income.threshold]] maximum

The OM's headline yield is 7.2% [[om.yield_stated]]. It is gross, on asking price, and built on potential rent at full occupancy. It is not a buyer's net yield on let units.

## What would make it fail
- The unit count falls outside the mandate range, which ends the deal.
- In-place rent is well below the OM's potential rent, so the real yield is lower than the headline.
- The OM's income uplift of c.AED 1.15m [[om.upside_claim_1]], about 12% [[disc.upside_exceeds_rera_cap.title]], does not happen. Renewal increases are limited by RERA rent-increase bands, and market rents have fallen.
- The lease expiry profile and over-renting are unknown. If expiries cluster or many leases sit above market, income is at risk.

## Discrepancies
Most severe first. Both items are medium severity. Lower-severity items are not discussed.

1. **Potential rent presented as income.** The OM labels the income as the current rent roll, but the figure assumes full occupancy while the same OM states 91% [[om.occupancy_stated]] occupancy. The 7.21% [[disc.potential_rent_as_income.title]] gross yield therefore counts rent on vacant units. It is on asking price with no operating costs deducted, so it overstates what a buyer receives today. The screen relied on the documents. Action: get a dated rent roll with contracted rent for let units only, recompute gross and net yield on let units, and reconcile to the trailing P&L.
2. **Uplift claim beyond RERA bands.** The OM bases the uplift on asking rents for new lettings. Increases on existing tenancies happen only at renewal, are capped by the gap to the RERA rental index, and need 90 [[disc.upside_exceeds_rera_cap.why]] days' notice. The OM mentions none of this, nor the fall in market rents. The claim is unlikely to be achievable and should not be used in pricing. Action: do not underwrite it, get the lease expiry schedule, test each renewal against the RERA rental index calculator, and compare passing rents with recent achieved transactions.

## Checks before diligence
- Confirm the unit count with a unit-by-unit schedule. This blocks everything else.
- Obtain the dated rent roll for let units only and reconcile it to the trailing P&L.
- Obtain the lease expiry schedule and test renewals against the RERA rental index.
- Compare passing rents with recent achieved transactions, not asking rents.
- Title deed and DLD ownership search: freehold, single title, buyer eligibility.
- Building completion certificate from Dubai Municipality.
- Affection plan and permitted use: residential use and permitted floors match the building.
- Ejari export for every lease, reconciled to the rent roll unit by unit.
- Civil Defence completion and annual fire-safety certificates, and ACP cladding compliance.

## Assumptions
No underwriting was run, so no exit yield, rent path, vacancy or leverage assumptions were applied. If the unit count clears the mandate, the walk-away price and returns will rest on the firm's house view (screen reference rent path, exit yield, vacancy and downtime), not on market evidence for this building. No mandate defaults were reported as filling gaps in the package. The operating statement covers 12 months [[opex.months]] and needed no annualising.
